title: When the Autopsy Falls
author: Noor Voss
blurb: Mara Vane, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
